description: Frame-by-frame coral growth: a round seed of seed_size, meshed at edge_length, grows in a solver. 22 bud centres sit evenly over the upper seed (seed turns them), each starting at its own frame; every frame each point moves out by rate × its growth, half along its normal and half away from the centre. Growth peaks at the bud centres, so knobs bulge out on narrow necks; lumpiness sets how much faster the buds grow than the surface between them (0 swells like a balloon) and splits each knob into lobes. Knobs that grow into each other push apart where they meet and leave a fold. The underside barely grows, so the form sits on its base. Each frame the surface is relaxed (Taubin, no shrinking) and remeshed to edge_length; past about 10,000 triangles the edges lengthen to keep the cook light. The form sits on the ground in a pale coral material, with the folds and valleys a deeper coral in Cd (vertex colour; the render multiplies it in). Cook any frame (24 fps): frame 1 is the seed.

seed_size.label: seed size
seed_size.desc: diameter of the round seed it grows from (m)

rate.label: rate
rate.desc: how far the surface grows each frame (m)

lumpiness.label: lumpiness
lumpiness.desc: how unevenly it grows: 0 swells like a balloon, 1 throws out knobs

edge_length.label: edge length
edge_length.desc: edge length the surface keeps as it grows (m); longer only past about 10,000 triangles

seed.label: seed
seed.desc: random seed of where the knobs come out

seed_mesh.note: the seed at edge_length; finer on a seed too small for it (4 edges across, never below 0.35 × edge_length), coarser past about 10,000 triangles

anchor.note: each point remembers its direction on the seed: the growth noise is read there, so knobs stay put as the form grows

buds.note: 22 bud centres spread evenly over the upper seed (a Fibonacci spiral turned by seed), each with its own size and the frame (2 to 9) it starts budding

area.note: surface area of the last frame, for the triangle budget

push.note: buds grow fastest at their centres (a smooth cap around each centre on the seed directions), so they bulge out on narrow necks; lumpiness also splits each bud into lobes (noise) and slows the growth between the buds

apart.note: lobes that grow into each other push apart where they meet, leaving a fold instead of crossing

even.note: back to edge_length (sqrt(area / 3200) keeps it under about 10,000 triangles)

tint.note: folds and valleys a deeper coral, knob tops pale (vertex colour; the render multiplies it into the material)

params.names: dir curvature bud_x bud_y bud_z bud_c bud_t

grows.note: the form holds at least the seed's volume (1e-6: float rounding only; at frame 1 the form is the seed)

form.label: Form
form.description: The form at the current frame: one closed, outward-facing triangle mesh with edges of about edge_length, sitting on the ground, in a pale coral material; point Cd darkens the folds and valleys.
